decisions.reason: F1 falsely makes semistability of a subrepresentation equivalent to its phase being at most that of an ambient object. For phi_1>phi_2, S_1 is stable, but phi(S_1)>phi(M_0), since the phase of z_1+z_2 lies strictly between the simple phases. The cited Definition instead requires every nonzero U contained in M to satisfy phi(U)<=phi(M). This is a false dependency restatement in the premise cited by Verification 3.1; F1 now gives the quantified criterion and strict stability criterion exactly.
